title: OmniRAS: Standardizing Foundation Model Training and Evaluation in Robot-Assisted Surgery
summary: Few foundation models exist for robot-assisted surgery, partly because large robotic-surgery video corpora are difficult to assemble and existing models are evaluated mostly on laparoscopic benchmarks. Further, most existing models are evaluated on a small set of public benchmarks, mostly focused on laparoscopic surgery. We present OmniRAS, a family of 1B- and 2B-parameter V-JEPA-2.1 encoders for robot-assisted surgery, and detail their training. First, we release two densely annotated robotic-cholecystectomy datasets: OmniRAS-PR and a multi-label YT-Chole tool-verb-target task, the first triplet-style annotation for robotic cholecystectomy, together with splits, probe protocols, and an inter-rater study validating the shared phase ontology. Second, we document continued pretraining at up to 256 compute nodes with global batch 6,144 over 19 sources totaling approximately 2,650 hours of surgical video, 51% robotic, and analyze compute and data composition. Third, we evaluate against raw V-JEPA-2.1 and specialized surgical models on six tasks spanning triplet, phase, and step recognition, action segmentation, and detection, under frozen-encoder and final-four-block fine-tuning regimes. Across three seeds, this yields 254 downstream runs, including 109 with partial backbone fine-tuning. The best OmniRAS models achieve the strongest adapted results across all task families, while frozen differences are smaller.
tldr: OmniRAS presents a family of V-JEPA-2.1 encoders (1B/2B parameters) for robot-assisted surgery, releasing two densely annotated cholecystectomy datasets, documenting large-scale continued pretraining on 2,650 hours of surgical video, and evaluating on six tasks across 254 downstream runs, achieving state-of-the-art adapted results.
tldr_zh: OmniRAS提出了一系列用于机器人辅助手术的V-JEPA-2.1编码器（1B/2B参数），发布了两个密集标注的胆囊切除术数据集，记录了在2650小时手术视频上的大规模持续预训练，并在六个任务上进行了254次下游运行评估，在微调设置下达到了最先进的结果。
summary_zh: 现有用于机器人辅助手术的基础模型很少，部分原因是大型机器人手术视频语料库难以构建，且现有模型大多在腹腔镜基准上进行评估。此外，大多数现有模型仅在一小部分公开基准上接受评估，且主要集中在腹腔镜手术领域。我们提出了OmniRAS——一组参数规模为1B和2B的V-JEPA-2.1编码器系列，用于机器人辅助手术，并详细介绍了其训练过程。首先，我们发布了两个密集标注的机器人胆囊切除术数据集：OmniRAS-PR和一个多标签YT-Chole工具-动词-目标任务数据集，这是首个针对机器人胆囊切除术的三元组风格标注，同时提供了数据划分、探针协议以及验证共享阶段本体的一致性的评分者间研究。其次，我们记录了在多达256个计算节点上进行的持续预训练，全局批量大小为6,144，数据来源涵盖19个源，总计约2,650小时的手术视频（其中51%为机器人手术），并分析了计算与数据组成。第三，我们在六个任务（涵盖三元组、阶段和步骤识别、动作分割以及目标检测）上，在冻结编码器和最后四块微调两种机制下，与原始V-JEPA-2.1及专门的手术模型进行了评估。基于三个随机种子，共产生254次下游实验，其中109次涉及骨干网络部分微调。最佳OmniRAS模型在所有任务族上均取得了最优的自适应结果，而冻结状态下的差异较小。

title: Multimodal Shared Latent Representation of Narration, Microscope and iOCT Images for Phase Recognition in Vitreoretinal Surgery
summary: Surgical phase recognition is key to context-aware computer-assisted feedback in vitreoretinal procedures, yet the scarcity of synchronized multimodal intraoperative data, particularly microscope views and intraoperative OCT, limits approaches that aim to replicate the multimodal integration surgeons perform naturally. Surgical narration, by contrast, is abundantly available online and offers rich semantic supervision. Prior work has mainly explored pairwise contrastive learning (e.g., intraoperative OCT-microscope or microscope-narration), leaving the joint modeling of all three modalities largely unexplored. We introduce a framework that uses microscope views as a shared anchor to bridge surgical narrations and intraoperative OCT (iOCT) without requiring a fully synchronized tri-modal dataset, leveraging real microscope-narration videos and a synthetic dataset of synchronized microscope video and tool-aligned iOCT pairs. Contrastive alignment transfers structural priors from the synthetic domain to real videos lacking iOCT, and a dual-head MS-TCN++ integrates the resulting embeddings for joint macro- and micro-phase prediction. Evaluated on real vitreoretinal surgeries, our framework improves macro-phase recognition over a zero-shot baseline (mean F1 0.38 to 0.53) and provides an exploratory route to estimating fine-grained instrument-tissue measurements that are not directly observable in real microscope video alone; these micro-phase estimates are validated quantitatively on synthetic data and shown only qualitatively on real surgery. To our knowledge, this is the first work to unify microscope view, iOCT B-scans, and surgical narrations in a shared latent space for surgical phase recognition.
tldr: This paper presents a framework that jointly models microscope views, intraoperative OCT (iOCT), and surgical narrations in a shared latent space for phase recognition in vitreoretinal surgery, using contrastive alignment and a dual-head MS-TCN++ to improve macro-phase recognition and estimate micro-phase measurements without needing fully synchronized tri-modal data.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出一个框架，将显微镜视图、术中OCT（iOCT）和手术叙述共同建模到共享潜在空间中，用于玻璃体视网膜手术的阶段识别。通过对比对齐和双头MS-TCN++，在无需完全同步的三模态数据的情况下，改善了宏观阶段识别并估计微观阶段测量。
summary_zh: 玻璃体视网膜手术中的手术阶段识别是实现上下文感知的计算机辅助反馈的关键，但术中多模态同步数据（尤其是显微镜视图与术中OCT）的稀缺性限制了旨在复现外科医生自然进行的多模态整合的研究方法。相比之下，手术旁白在网络上资源丰富，并能提供丰富的语义监督。以往研究主要探索成对对比学习（如术中OCT-显微镜或显微镜-旁白），而三种模态的联合建模仍基本未被探索。我们提出了一种框架，利用显微镜视图作为共享锚点，桥接手术旁白与术中OCT（iOCT），无需完全同步的三模态数据集，而是借助真实的显微镜-旁白视频以及由同步显微镜视频与工具对齐的iOCT对组成的合成数据集。对比对齐将合成领域的结构先验迁移至缺乏iOCT的真实视频，而双头MS-TCN++整合生成的嵌入以实现宏观与微观阶段的联合预测。在真实玻璃体视网膜手术上的评估表明，我们的框架将宏观阶段识别相对零样本基线有所提升（平均F1从0.38提升至0.53），并为估计仅凭真实显微镜视频无法直接观察到的精细器械-组织测量提供了探索性途径；这些微观阶段估计在合成数据上进行了定量验证，在真实手术中仅以定性方式展示。据我们所知，这是首个在共享潜在空间中统一显微镜视图、iOCT B扫描与手术旁白以实现手术阶段识别的工作。

title: GPAgentBench-2K: Benchmarking Large Language Model Agents in Complex Clinical Action Space
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) show great potential as clinical agents, yet existing benchmarks reduce clinical workflows to static predictions or unconstrained Markov Decision Processes (MDPs) with coarse action sets. To address this, we introduce GPAgentBench-2K, the first Constrained MDP (CMDP) LLM-agent benchmark for primary-care clinical decision-making, constructed from expert-validated records of real-world GP encounters. Our environment models a full spectrum of six foundational clinical actions, imposes a topological workflow prior over the action space, and operationalizes safety-informed abstention as a first-class outcome. Evaluating 16 state-of-the-art LLMs reveals a significant performance degradation as the action space scales. Crucially, we uncover a clinical quality-safety gap: even frontier models with the highest diagnosis accuracy violate safety constraints in over half of high-risk cases. Finally, we establish a reference point using Constrained Group Relative Policy Optimization (C-GRPO), and show that while explicitly modeling constraints improves performance over unconstrained RL methods, it remains far from clinically acceptable safety.
tldr: This paper introduces GPAgentBench-2K, the first constrained MDP (CMDP) benchmark for evaluating LLM agents in primary-care clinical decision-making, revealing a quality-safety gap where even top models violate safety constraints in high-risk cases.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了GPAgentBench-2K，首个用于评估大语言模型智能体在初级保健临床决策中的约束MDP基准，揭示了即使最先进的模型在高风险案例中也会违反安全约束的质量-安全差距。
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）作为临床智能体展现出巨大潜力，然而现有基准将临床工作流程简化为静态预测或具有粗粒度动作集合的无约束马尔可夫决策过程（MDPs）。为解决此问题，我们提出GPAgentBench-2K——首个面向初级保健临床决策的约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP）LLM智能体基准，该基准基于真实全科医生诊疗记录经专家验证构建。我们的环境建模了六类基础临床行为的完整范围，在动作空间上施加了拓扑化工作流先验，并将安全感知的弃权操作作为一类首要结果实现。对16个最先进LLM的评估显示，随着动作空间规模扩大，性能显著下降。关键在于，我们发现了一个临床质量-安全差距：即使是诊断准确率最高的前沿模型，在超过半数高风险案例中也违反了安全约束。最后，我们采用约束组相对策略优化（C-GRPO）建立了参考基准，结果表明，尽管显式建模约束相较于无约束强化学习方法提升了性能，但距离临床可接受的安全水平仍有很大差距。

title: Evidence, Logic, and Compliance: Multi-Agent Structured Graph Reasoning with Expert Arbitration for Medical Referral
summary: Medical referral (directing patients to the appropriate hospital department) is a complex decision-making process requiring the synthesis of multimodal data, including patient narratives, laboratory indicators, and radiology imaging. While Large Language Models (LLMs) have advanced medical dialogue systems, they struggle with real-world referral tasks due to two primary limitations: (1) Information Overload, where models fixate on high-frequency disease terms while overlooking subtle but critical urgency indicators; and (2) Unstructured Collaboration, where existing multi-agent frameworks rely on loose dialogue that leads to semantic drift and confirmation bias. To address these challenges, we introduce MASGR (Multi-Agent Structured Graph Reasoning), a framework that treats referral not as a classification task but as a structured graph construction problem. MASGR deploys specialized agents to extract evidence from distinct modalities and coordinates them through a clinical reasoning graph. This graph forces agents to establish explicit logical connections between conflicting evidence. Furthermore, we integrate a knowledge-guided arbitration mechanism that prioritizes patient safety rules over standard diagnostic classification. Extensive experiments on real-world medical records demonstrate that MASGR significantly outperforms state-of-the-art LLMs and existing multi-agent systems, particularly in complex cases requiring the balancing of chronic disease management and emergency intervention. The AI contribution lies in the Multi-Agent Structured Graph Reasoning framework that transforms unstructured multi-agent dialogue into a verifiable logical graph construction. The engineering application is demonstrated through its deployment in a complex healthcare decision-making system to optimize the precision of complex medical referrals.
tldr: MASGR transforms medical referral from a classification task into a structured graph construction problem using specialized agents and clinical reasoning graphs, outperforming existing LLMs and multi-agent systems in complex cases.
tldr_zh: MASGR将医疗转诊从分类任务转化为结构化图构建问题，通过专业代理和临床推理图，在复杂病例中优于现有的大语言模型和多代理系统。
summary_zh:
摘要：
医疗转诊（引导患者至合适的医院科室）是一个复杂的决策过程，需要综合多模态数据，包括患者叙述、实验室指标和放射影像。尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）推动了医疗对话系统的发展，但在实际转诊任务中仍面临两大局限：（1）信息过载，模型过度关注高频疾病术语，而忽略细微但关键的危险信号；（2）非结构化协作，现有智能体框架依赖松散的对话，导致语义漂移和确认偏差。为解决这些问题，我们提出MASGR（多智能体结构化图推理）框架，该框架将转诊视为一个结构化图构建问题，而非分类任务。MASGR部署专用智能体从不同模态中提取证据，并通过临床推理图协调它们。该图迫使智能体在相互矛盾的证据之间建立明确的逻辑联系。此外，我们整合了一个知识引导的仲裁机制，将患者安全规则置于标准诊断分类之上。在真实医疗记录上的大量实验表明，MASGR显著优于现有的大型语言模型和多智能体系统，尤其是在需要平衡慢性病管理与紧急干预的复杂病例中。人工智能贡献在于多智能体结构化图推理框架，该框架将非结构化多智能体对话转化为可验证的逻辑图构建。工程应用体现为其在复杂医疗决策系统中的部署，以优化复杂医疗转诊的精准度。

title: DIASENTINEL: An Auditable Multi-Agent System for Guideline-Grounded Diabetes Risk Screening
summary: Large language models (LLMs) offer promising clinical decision support but remain vulnerable to hallucinated facts, unsupported recommendations, and citation errors. We present DIASENTINEL, a fully on-premise multi-agent system for one-year type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) risk screening and guideline-grounded report generation from electronic health records (EHRs). The system integrates calibrated risk prediction, deterministic clinical signal extraction, Reciprocal Rank Fusion over American Diabetes Association (ADA) guidelines, and a hybrid verification layer combining rule-based checks with LLM entailment. The demonstration provides a real-time batch-screening dashboard and an interactive patient report interface with cited recommendations, verification results, and raw EHR comparison. DIASENTINEL demonstrates a practical framework for reliable, auditable, and privacy-preserving LLM-based clinical decision support.
tldr: DIASENTINEL is an on-premise multi-agent system that uses LLMs for T2DM risk screening from EHRs, integrating calibrated risk prediction, deterministic signal extraction, guideline retrieval with Reciprocal Rank Fusion, and hybrid verification to produce auditable, cited reports.
tldr_zh: DIASENTINEL 是一个本地化的多代理系统，利用大型语言模型从电子健康记录中进行 2 型糖尿病风险筛查，集成校准风险预测、确定性信号提取、基于倒数排序融合的指南检索以及混合验证，生成可审计、有引用的报告。
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在临床决策支持方面展现出良好前景，但仍易出现事实幻觉、无依据建议及引用错误等问题。我们提出DIASENTINEL系统——一个完全本地部署的多智能体系统，用于从电子健康记录（EHRs）中进行一年期2型糖尿病（T2DM）风险筛查并生成基于指南的报告。该系统集成了校准的风险预测、确定性临床信号提取、基于美国糖尿病协会（ADA）指南的倒数排序融合（Reciprocal Rank Fusion），以及一个结合规则检查与LLM蕴含推理的混合验证层。该演示提供了实时批量筛查仪表盘，以及一个包含引用建议、验证结果和原始EHR对比的交互式患者报告界面。DIASENTINEL展示了一个可靠、可审计且保护隐私的LLM临床决策支持实用框架。

title: Automatic Conversion of NICE Guidelines to an Executable Computational Model Using Large Language Models
summary: Introduction: NICE guidelines provide evidence-based recommendations for clinical care but remain largely in unstructured natural language. Existing approaches to converting them into computable representations often focus on individual diseases, require substantial manual encoding, and do not scale. Large language models (LLMs) may enable much of this translation to be automated. Methods: We present an end-to-end approach that converts textual clinical guidelines into executable models capable of generating explainable, patient-specific recommendations. A stepwise LLM-based transformation with in-context examples produces human-inspectable intermediate artifacts. We apply the approach to NICE pancreatic and lung cancer guidelines, use expert review to assess rule alignment, and evaluate the executable pancreatic cancer model on 20 patient vignettes. Results: Expert review showed strong alignment between the source guidelines and generated executable models. Most discrepancies were partial omissions rather than incorrect logic, while hallucinated or fundamentally incorrect rules were rare. On the patient vignettes, the executable model achieved an F1 score of 82.5%. Conclusion: LLMs can transform natural-language NICE guidelines into interpretable, executable models that preserve guideline structure, support transparent inspection and modification, and generate patient-specific recommendations. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of scalable automated generation of computable clinical guidelines.
tldr: This paper presents an end-to-end method using large language models to automatically convert unstructured NICE clinical guidelines into executable computational models that generate patient-specific recommendations, demonstrating feasibility on pancreatic and lung cancer guidelines.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种端到端方法，利用大型语言模型将非结构化的NICE临床指南自动转换为可执行的计算模型，该模型能够生成患者特异性建议，并在胰腺癌和肺癌指南上验证了可行性。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
引言：NICE指南为临床诊疗提供了基于证据的建议，但主要以非结构化的自然语言形式存在。现有将其转化为可计算表示的方法通常聚焦于单一疾病，需要大量人工编码，且难以扩展。大型语言模型（LLM）或可实现该转化过程的大部分自动化。方法：我们提出了一种端到端方法，将文本形式的临床指南转化为可执行模型，该模型能够生成可解释、针对具体患者的建议。基于LLM的逐步转换结合上下文示例，生成可供人工审查的中间产物。我们将该方法应用于NICE胰腺癌和肺癌指南，通过专家评审评估规则一致性，并在20个患者案例上对可执行的胰腺癌模型进行评价。结果：专家评审显示源指南与生成的可执行模型之间具有高度一致性。多数差异表现为部分遗漏而非逻辑错误，而幻觉或根本性错误的规则极为罕见。在患者案例测试中，该可执行模型的F1分数达到82.5%。结论：LLM能够将自然语言形式的NICE指南转化为可解释、可执行的模型，该模型保留指南结构，支持透明审查与修改，并可生成针对具体患者的建议。这些发现证明了可扩展自动化生成可计算临床指南的可行性。

title: Co-Annotator: Expert-Distilled ViT and VLM for Visual and Documentation Guidance in Age-Related Macular Degeneration
summary: Clinical AI often optimizes predictive performance without engaging how clinicians decide where to look and what to write. We present Co-Annotator, which distills expert gaze and dictation into two guidance components: a gaze-aligned Vision Transformer producing fixation-aligned areas of interest (AOIs), and an ontology-bounded vision-language model (VLM) that pre-fills editable biomarker summaries for retinal optical coherence tomography (OCT). We first collect expert gaze and dictations (US1) to train the models, significantly improving diagnostic accuracy and biomarker generation. We then deploy the system with ophthalmology residents: a controlled resident study (US2) confirmed each modality is safe and independently beneficial, with AOI guidance producing lasting perceptual efficiency gains through post-guidance carryover and VLM guidance more than doubling biomarker documentation breadth. In a combined deployment across two academic institutions (US3), providing both modalities simultaneously produced efficiency gains that substantially exceeded either modality alone: correct diagnoses per minute increased by 40% and comment editing time fell by 67%, without compromising diagnostic accuracy. Notably, neither modality improved efficiency during guidance in US2, which makes the in-guidance efficiency gain under combined guidance in US3 the more striking result. Expert-distilled multimodal guidance can remove two distinct clinical workflow bottlenecks at once (visual search overhead and documentation burden) without compromising the diagnostic accuracy clinicians already achieve.
tldr: Co-Annotator distills expert gaze and dictation into a gaze-aligned ViT and an ontology-bounded VLM to provide visual and documentation guidance for retinal OCT diagnosis, improving efficiency and biomarker documentation without compromising accuracy.
tldr_zh: Co-Annotator将专家的注视和口述蒸馏为注视对齐的ViT和基于本体的VLM，为视网膜OCT诊断提供视觉和文档指导，在不影响准确性的前提下提高效率和生物标志物记录广度。
summary_zh: 临床AI通常致力于优化预测性能，却未考虑临床医生如何决定观察目标及书写内容。我们提出Co-Annotator系统，将专家注视与口述提炼为两种引导组件：一种注视对齐的视觉Transformer，用于生成注视对齐的兴趣区域（AOI）；以及一种本体约束的视觉语言模型（VLM），可预填视网膜光学相干断层扫描（OCT）的可编辑生物标志物摘要。我们首先采集专家注视与口述数据（US1）训练模型，显著提升了诊断准确性与生物标志物生成能力。随后在眼科住院医师中部署该系统：一项受控住院医师研究（US2）证实，每种模态均安全且独立有益——AOI引导通过后引导延续效应带来了持久的感知效率提升，VLM引导则将生物标志物记录广度提升一倍以上。在两个学术机构的联合部署中（US3），同时提供两种模态所产生的效率提升显著超过单一模态：每分钟正确诊断数增加40%，评论编辑时间减少67%，且未影响诊断准确性。值得注意的是，在US2中，单一模态在引导期间均未提升效率，这使得US3中联合引导下引导期间的效率提升成为更引人注目的结果。专家提炼的多模态引导可同时消除两个不同的临床工作流程瓶颈（视觉搜索开销与记录负担），且不影响临床医生已有的诊断准确性。

title: Federated Multi-Task Learning for Bladder Tumor Segmentation and MIBC Classification Using a Hybrid CNN-Transformer Architecture
summary: Accurate bladder tumor segmentation and assessment of mus- cle invasion from T2-weighted MRI are important for treatment plan- ning, but developing robust models across institutions is challenging be- cause patient data cannot be centrally pooled and imaging characteristics vary across scanners and acquisition protocols. We propose a federated multi-task learning framework for joint bladder tumor segmentation and MIBC/NMIBC classification across four clinical centers. The proposed Swin Hybrid model combines a ResNet-34 branch for local texture and boundary information with a Swin-Tiny Transformer for global anatomi- cal context. A segmentation-guided classification mechanism further uses tumor localization information to support MIBC prediction. We also investigate several augmentation strategies under both centralized and federated training to improve robustness to multi-center variability. Ex- periments on the FedBCa dataset show that the Swin Hybrid provides the best overall balance between segmentation and classification among the evaluated architectures. Under federated training, Geo+Elastic aug- mentation achieved a DSC of 0.8100 and a patient-level AUC of 0.8931, yielding the highest combined score of 0.8474. These results demonstrate that joint segmentation and classification can be effectively performed across multiple institutions using federated training without centralizing patient data.
tldr: This paper proposes a federated multi-task learning framework that jointly segments bladder tumors and classifies muscle invasion (MIBC/NMIBC) from T2-weighted MRI across multiple clinical centers, using a hybrid CNN-Transformer (ResNet-34 + Swin-Tiny) with segmentation-guided classification.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种联邦多任务学习框架，联合分割膀胱肿瘤并从T2加权MRI中分类肌层浸润（MIBC/NMIBC），跨多个临床中心使用混合CNN-Transformer（ResNet-34 + Swin-Tiny）并结合分割引导的分类机制。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
从T2加权MRI中准确进行膀胱肿瘤分割和肌肉侵犯评估对治疗规划至关重要，但由于患者数据无法集中汇总，且不同扫描仪和采集协议的成像特征存在差异，因此跨机构开发鲁棒模型具有挑战性。我们提出了一种联邦多任务学习框架，用于在四个临床中心联合进行膀胱肿瘤分割和MIBC/NMIBC分类。所提出的Swin混合模型结合了用于局部纹理和边界信息的ResNet-34分支，以及用于全局解剖上下文的Swin-Tiny Transformer。分割引导的分类机制进一步利用肿瘤定位信息支持MIBC预测。我们还研究了集中式训练和联邦训练下的几种数据增强策略，以提高对多中心变异性的鲁棒性。在FedBCa数据集上的实验表明，在所评估的架构中，Swin混合模型在分割和分类之间提供了最佳的整体平衡。在联邦训练下，Geo+Elastic增强实现了0.8100的DSC和0.8931的患者级别AUC，产生了最高的综合得分0.8474。这些结果表明，无需集中患者数据，即可通过联邦训练在多机构间有效执行联合分割与分类。

title: CoLa-ICD: A Knowledge-Enhanced Framework for Long-Tail Automated Medical Coding
summary: Automatic medical coding assigns ICD codes to clinical notes, but it remains challenging due to long documents, imbalanced label distributions, and diverse terms. These challenges are especially severe for rare codes, which have limited training instances and are easily confused with semantically similar labels. We introduce CoLa-ICD, a knowledge-enhanced framework for long-tail prediction. CoLa-ICD enriches ICD labels with external terms, models dependencies among related codes, and learns stronger alignment between label semantics and clinical evidence for long-tail prediction. Experiments show that CoLa-ICD improves long-tail prediction with larger gains in larger and sparser label spaces and achieves state-of-the-art performance in AUC, F1, and P@k. Our code is available at https://github.com/youwillbethebest/Cola-ICD.
tldr: CoLa-ICD is a knowledge-enhanced framework that enriches ICD labels with external terms and models code dependencies to improve long-tail automated medical coding, achieving state-of-the-art performance on clinical notes.
tldr_zh: CoLa-ICD 是一个知识增强框架，通过丰富ICD标签的外部术语和建模代码依赖关系，改善了长尾自动医学编码，在临床笔记上达到了最先进的性能。
summary_zh: 自动医疗编码将ICD代码分配给临床记录，但由于文档冗长、标签分布不均衡以及术语多样化，这一任务仍具挑战性。这些挑战对稀有代码尤为严峻，因其训练实例有限且容易与语义相似的标签混淆。我们提出CoLa-ICD，一种面向长尾预测的知识增强框架。CoLa-ICD通过外部术语丰富ICD标签、对相关代码之间的依赖关系进行建模，并学习标签语义与临床证据之间更强的对齐，以改进长尾预测。实验表明，CoLa-ICD在更大且更稀疏的标签空间中取得更显著的增益，并在AUC、F1和P@k指标上达到当前最优性能。我们的代码可在https://github.com/youwillbethebest/Cola-ICD获取。

title: Error Detection for PET/CT Radiology Reports: Domain-Specific vs Large Language Models
summary: Errors in radiology reports can adversely affect patient treatment, yet automated report quality assurance remains challenging because errors are often subtle and require domain expertise to detect. Although large language models (LLMs) have recently been proposed for radiology report verification, their ability to detect clinically meaningful errors beyond chest X-ray datasets remains under-explored. To this end, we present the first systematic evaluation of language models for PET/CT report error detection, comparing compact domain-specific models with SOTA open-weight LLMs. We collected 30,633 oncology FDG PET/CT reports from 23 radiologists over 10 years. We trained domain-specific BERT models to detect clinically motivated synthetic reporting errors and evaluated alongside zero-/few-shot Qwen3-32B, Gemma-3-27B and Llama-3.3-70B on a held-out benchmark of 11,500 reports. A 15M-parameter model achieved 94.4% balanced accuracy with a 5.8% false-positive rate, compared with 84.0% for the strongest prompted LLM. Task-specific adaptation of Llama-3.3-70B closed this performance gap (94.4%) but retained substantially greater computational requirements. Our results suggest that domain-specific training matters more than model scale for PET/CT report error detection, supporting compact models as an accurate and computationally efficient approach to automated radiology report quality assurance.
tldr: This paper systematically evaluates domain-specific BERT models vs. large language models (LLMs) for detecting clinically meaningful errors in PET/CT radiology reports, finding that a compact 15M-parameter BERT model achieves 94.4% balanced accuracy, outperforming zero-/few-shot LLMs and matching fine-tuned LLMs with far lower computational cost.
tldr_zh: 本文系统评估了领域专用BERT模型与大语言模型（LLMs）在PET/CT放射报告错误检测中的表现，发现紧凑的15M参数BERT模型达到94.4%平衡准确率，优于零样本/少样本LLM，与微调LLM性能相当但计算成本更低。
summary_zh: 放射学报告中的错误可能对患者治疗产生不利影响，然而自动化报告质量保证仍然具有挑战性，因为错误通常很隐蔽，需要专业知识才能发现。尽管大型语言模型（LLM）近期已被提出用于放射学报告验证，但它们在胸部X射线数据集之外检测有临床意义错误的能力仍有待探索。为此，我们首次对用于PET/CT报告错误检测的语言模型进行了系统评估，将紧凑的领域特定模型与最先进的开源权重LLM进行了比较。我们收集了来自23位放射科医生、跨越10年的30,633份肿瘤FDG PET/CT报告。我们训练了领域特定的BERT模型来检测具有临床意义的合成报告错误，并在包含11,500份报告的保留基准测试中，与零样本/少样本的Qwen3-32B、Gemma-3-27B和Llama-3.3-70B进行了对比评估。一个1500万参数的模型达到了94.4%的平衡准确率和5.8%的假阳性率，而最强的提示LLM则为84.0%。Llama-3.3-70B的任务特定适配缩小了这一性能差距（94.4%），但仍然保留了显著更高的计算需求。我们的结果表明，对于PET/CT报告错误检测，领域特定训练比模型规模更重要，支持将紧凑模型作为自动化放射学报告质量保证的一种准确且计算高效的方法。

title: CheXGround: Anatomical Region Tokens for Grounded Longitudinal Chest X-ray Interpretation
summary: Recent radiology multi-modal language models have made substantial progress in chest X-ray report generation, visual question answering, and temporal reasoning. While longitudinal chest X-ray interpretation compares sequential examinations to describe change, visual grounding aims to connect clinical language with localized image evidence. Although longitudinal modeling and visual grounding have each advanced radiology language models, how localized visual evidence can support longitudinal interpretation remains under-explored. We introduce CheXGround, a region-grounded longitudinal chest X-ray language model that represents paired studies through corresponding anatomical regions. CheXGround extracts anatomical regions from current and prior radiographs, encodes them as temporally enhanced Region-of-Interest (ROI) tokens, and combines them with global temporal image context during generation. To connect these region tokens with clinical text, we propose Temporal Region--Phrase Alignment, a pretraining objective that aligns temporal anatomical representations with localized report phrases. We evaluate CheXGround on single-study and longitudinal Visual Question Answering (VQA), longitudinal findings generation, temporal grounded VQA, and anatomical grounding. Across these tasks, CheXGround improves clinical language quality, temporal reasoning, and localization accuracy over recent baselines. Our results suggest that organizing longitudinal evidence at the anatomical level is a strong representation for grounded radiology language modeling. Project page: https://adonaydem.github.io/chexground-website
tldr: CheXGround introduces a region-grounded longitudinal chest X-ray language model that uses temporally enhanced ROI tokens and a novel Temporal Region-Phrase Alignment pretraining objective to improve visual grounding and temporal reasoning in radiology report generation and VQA.
tldr_zh: CheXGround 提出了一种基于区域定位的纵向胸部X光语言模型，利用时间增强的感兴趣区域令牌和新的时间区域-短语对齐预训练目标，提升了放射学报告生成和视觉问答中的视觉定位与时间推理能力。
summary_zh: 近期放射学多模态语言模型在胸部X光报告生成、视觉问答及时间推理方面取得了显著进展。纵向胸部X光解读通过对比序列检查描述变化，而视觉定位旨在将临床语言与局部图像证据相关联。尽管纵向建模与视觉定位各自推动了放射学语言模型的发展，但局部视觉证据如何支撑纵向解读仍有待探索。我们提出CheXGround——一种基于区域定位的纵向胸部X光语言模型，通过对应解剖区域表征配对检查。CheXGround从当前和既往X光片中提取解剖区域，将其编码为时间增强的感兴趣区域（ROI）标记，并在生成过程中与全局时间图像上下文结合。为将这些区域标记与临床文本关联，我们提出时间区域-短语对齐这一预训练目标，将时间解剖表示与局部报告短语对齐。我们在单次研究及纵向视觉问答、纵向发现生成、时间定位VQA及解剖定位任务上评估了CheXGround。在这些任务中，CheXGround相较于近期基线在临床语言质量、时间推理及定位准确性方面均有提升。结果表明，在解剖层面组织纵向证据是实现定位放射学语言建模的有力表征。项目页面：https://adonaydem.github.io/chexground-website
